newsitem.title: UK: Rubicon sees improved earnings in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Rubicon sees improved earnings in 97/98.

text.p: British engineering company Rubicon Group Plc said on Wednesday it expected earnings to improve in the financial years to May 1997 and to May 1998 on the back of its rationalisation programme.

"The board is confident in the inherent strength of all the group's divisions and the prospects remain good, with new projects coming into production in the early months of the next financial year," Rubicon said in a statement.
Rubicon said it intended to continue with a "progressive" dividend policy.
In the six months to November 30, 1996, Rubicon declared an interim ordinary dividend of 2.2p per share, unchanged from a year earlier.
